scope: single frozen logical computation; no automatic second scientific observation

states.recovery: Reconcile live head and all artifacts; any fresh ARM requires a separate exact-head governance decision. Workflow rerun is rejected.
Read canonical remote ref. Within the same surviving owner process, identical fence commit confirms success. Otherwise stop; never infer nonopening from lost acknowledgement.
No automatic reexecution. Surviving local evidence may narrow classification, but absence of the local lock is not proof that no worker ran. Preserve the fence permanently.
No null, closure, accepted result or automatic retry. Preserve evidence. A separate future governance decision must explicitly address possible prior observation; deleting the fence is forbidden.

Recover the exact completed result and prepared attestation from the surviving local files or authenticated workflow artifact. Verify self-digest, frozen provenance and prepared hash against the durable fence; publish those bytes only. Never rerun the evaluator.
Idempotently reconcile the identical commit. No recomputation, interpretation or second canonical result.
Stop. Interpretation and later research require separate governance.

unavoidable_window_proof: Git fence publication, evaluation in a separate process, local atomic rename and remote result publication are not one atomic transaction. SIGKILL/host loss immediately before or immediately after the first response read can leave the same durable fence and no recoverable local result. No observer can distinguish those executions from identical durable state. Guarantee at-most-one authorized invocation and exactly-one accepted canonical result if a valid result survives; never claim guaranteed exactly-once completion across arbitrary host loss.
mitigations: exact-parent ARM without recursive commit hash
prevalidate inputs and frozen runner before fence
explicit expected-ref leases including ancestor-reset rejection
immutable numerical image and hash-locked wheel
no automatic recomputation or fence deletion
artifact_limitation: An always-run upload mitigates ordinary step/push failures but cannot promise recovery after abrupt host termination before upload. Missing artifacts remain unknown, not scientific evidence.
